title: Act and Remember: two boundaries left out {{amber:on purpose}}.
head: Skipped boundary
What it would add
Why we leave it out

rows.label: Act
cells: the model decides to call tools and APIs
reopens the spend problem the cost caps solved; the human owns the decision

rows.label: Remember
cells: semantic retrieval + a memory the agents read
structured context suffices; memory is designed but unwired

takeaway.text: The strongest boundary is sometimes the one you {{amber:don't}} build. Naming the boundary tells you the contract - and sometimes it is {{red:none}}.
